title: Lesson 10 - I Didn't Know You Two Knew Each Other

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Aisha? Hi. I didn't expect to see you here.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Hi, Daniel. I was checking the events board when Lena came over.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: And I recognized her from a workshop.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Wait—I didn't know you two knew each other. How do you two know each other?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: We met at a public poster-making workshop here.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: When did you meet?

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Two weeks ago. Aisha was looking for Room 204 when I saw her in the lobby.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: And Lena was putting up direction signs when I came in. I asked her where the class was.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: One of my signs was pointing toward the wrong stairs, so my answer wasn't very helpful.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: We were walking upstairs when we noticed the mistake.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: What happened then?

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: We fixed the sign and found the right room.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: How did that go?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Fine. We laughed about it and talked on the way. The workshop started a few minutes later.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: So that's how you met.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Exactly.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: What were you talking about?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Mostly design work and why I signed up for the class.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: I asked about her freelance work, and she asked about the center. That was our whole conversation.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: I was imagining a secret project that everyone knew about except me.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Sorry to disappoint you. We recognized each other, that's all.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: No secret project. Just one workshop, one wrong sign, and a short conversation.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Still—small world. My neighbor and my cousin met before I introduced them.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Now you know.
